outlet: Moscow-Pullman Daily News, "Numerous Whitman County levies to appear on general election ballot" (Emily Pearce, 2024-10-18)
notes: Lists the November 2024 town levies with amounts and cost per $100,000: Palouse $55,000/$50,000/$50,000, Rosalia $50,000, St. John $80,000 street and $60,000 water and sewer, Tekoa $50,000, Uniontown two-year park and library levies.
